project_description: Case-control study using 16S rRNA gene sequencing of fecal microbiota and targeted LC-MS plasma metabolomics in 60 patients with generalized anxiety disorder versus 30 healthy volunteers.
citation: Li et al. 2025, Int J Neurosci, PMID 40601331
notes: Abstract (Results): 'GAD was associated with increased abundances of Actinobacteria, Bacteroidetes, and Escherichia-Shigella and decreased abundances of Firmicutes, Roseburia, Bifidobacterium, and Prevotellaceae_Prevotella.' Escherichia-Shigella is a 16S-based combined genus grouping (Escherichia and Shigella are not resolved by 16S rRNA). No exact per-taxon p-value given in extractable abstract text.

project_description: Case-control study using whole-genome shotgun metagenomic sequencing of fecal samples from 31 adults with a clinical diagnosis of social anxiety disorder versus 18 age- and sex-matched healthy controls.
citation: Butler et al. 2023, Transl Psychiatry, PMID 36941248
notes: Abstract: 'The relative abundance of the genera Anaeromassillibacillus and Gordonibacter were elevated in SAD.' Genus spelling standardized to Anaeromassilibacillus (single L) to match the species-level mention in the same abstract (Anaeromassilibacillus sp An250). Genus-level difference was significant after Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction per full text; exact numeric q-value not given at genus level (species-level padj=0.024 reported for Anaeromassilibacillus sp. An250).

project_description: Umbrella systematic review and meta-analysis of 59 case-control gut microbiota studies (16S rRNA/shotgun metagenomics) across adult psychiatric disorders, including case-control studies of adults with a clinical diagnosis of anxiety disorder versus controls.
citation: Nikolova et al. 2021, JAMA Psychiatry, PMID 34524405
notes: Abstract: 'Depleted levels of Faecalibacterium and Coprococcus and enriched levels of Eggerthella were consistently shared between major depressive disorder, bipolar disorder, psychosis and schizophrenia, and anxiety.' Transdiagnostic finding explicitly including anxiety-disorder case-control studies; no anxiety-specific exact p-value given in extractable abstract text.
